title: agent-message-sent
description: The agent route's reply to send, steer and follow_up (agent message create), and the CLI's typed result: the message the agent sent to another of the person's conversations. message_id is the command id, carried in the receiver's <agent-message> block; to, title and workspace_id name the receiver; conversation_url opens it and message_url opens it at this message. delivery is the kind asked for and state the admission (pending: given to Pi or queued behind its turn; held: Pi starts for it). text is the agent's message without the daemon's block; quote the quoted message as the receiver reads it. A repeated command id answers with the plain receipt fields only.
